\[
\begin{array}{ll}
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\boldsymbol{x}_{0}=0, \boldsymbol{r}_{0}=\boldsymbol{b}, \boldsymbol{d}_{0}=\boldsymbol{r}_{0}} \\
\multicolumn{2}{l}{\textbf{for } n=1 \textbf{ to } N} \\

\quad \boldsymbol{d}_{n}=\boldsymbol{r}_{n}+\beta_{n} \boldsymbol{d}_{n-1} & \text{next search direction} \\
